FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 240
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Rep. Lovvorn
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/21/2025
House Bill 240 as introduced could decrease income tax receipts to the Education Trust Fund
by an undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of income earned by student athletes
for their name, image, and likeness.
